occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Observed a 7 month old infant with a blanket in the pack and play. This was corrected whent he blanket was removed.     An administrative penalty will be recommended as a result of this citation, per HRC ?42.078.

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: Observed a 7 month old infant sleeping with a bottle. This was corrected when the bottle was taken out of the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §747.2319(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: An infant was found asleep in a car seat while in care. This was corrected when the operation staff was asked to remove the infant from the car seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: Observed an infant sleeping with a bottle. This was corrected when the infant was taken out of the car seat and it was explained that the infant cannot sleep with a bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §747.2319(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Observed the television on and all children were watching paw patrol. I explained that children under 2 cannot have any screen time and the television was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not have proof that a fire drill had been completed. There was no form to review. A fire drill was completed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Observed a caregiver place a blanket over an infant that was sleeping in the crib. This was corrected when the blanket was removed.   An administrative penalty will be recommended as a result of this citation, per HRC ?42.078.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §747.2315(b))

occurrences.finding: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year: The operation did not have proof that a lock down drill had been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Observed 4 children records out of 11 children and none of the children had health statements
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There was one infant that did not have feeding instructions for review.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Rings,Trapeze Bars, Free-Swinging Ropes: Observed swinging bars on the playground equipment. I spoke with the primary caregiver about it being a prohibited item for the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Rings,Trapeze Bars, Free-Swinging Ropes (26 TAC §747.4403(4))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Observed an infant that had been in the car seat for 2 1/2 hours. This was corrected when the infant was removed upon request from Licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §747.2317(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training: The operation could not provide proof of any training for the caregiver for year 2024-2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers Licensed -24 hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time a non-client resident 14 or older moves into your home or operation: Observed 3 adults in the home that do not have cleared background checks to be around the children. One caregiver was asked to leave the facility during the inspection.  An administrative penalty will be recommended as a result of this citation, per HRC ?42.078.
